title: Ranibizumab for Neovascularization in Sickle Cell Retinopathy
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the ocular and non-ocular safety of a single dose of ranibizumab in treating neovascularization secondary to sickle cell retinopathy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with sickle cell anemia and retinopathy
* Over age 18 years
* Non-pregnant

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant
* Glaucoma
* Patients using anticoagulants (e.g., warfarin)
* Retinal detachment
